options.command: bash -c 'if command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then terraform -chdir=infra/terraform fmt -recursive; else echo "terraform not installed; skipped fmt"; fi'

bash -c 'if command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/environments/dev init -backend=false >/dev/null && terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/environments/dev validate; else echo "terraform not installed; skipped validate"; fi'
bash -c 'if command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then terraform -chdir=infra/terraform/environments/dev plan -input=false; else echo "terraform not installed; skipped plan"; fi'
